arguments.sql:
SELECT r.date, r.time AS race_time, c.location, c.country,
       f.time AS elapsed_time, f.milliseconds, typeof(f.milliseconds) AS milliseconds_type,
       d.forename, d.surname, d.url, p.lap AS first_stop_lap, p.time AS first_stop_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN results AS f ON f.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = f.driverId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId AND p.driverId = d.driverId AND p.stop = 1
WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND f.position = 1

arguments.sql:
WITH lap_clock AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap,
           SUM(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY l.raceId, l.driverId ORDER BY l.lap) AS cumulative_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS l
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
)
SELECT p.driverId, p.stop, p.lap, p.time, l.cumulative_ms,
       strftime('%H:%M:%f', p.time, printf('-%f seconds', l.cumulative_ms / 1000.0)) AS pit_time_minus_laps
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN lap_clock AS l ON l.raceId = p.raceId AND l.driverId = p.driverId AND l.lap = p.lap
ORDER BY p.lap, p.time
LIMIT 20

arguments.sql:
WITH lap_clock AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap,
           SUM(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY l.raceId, l.driverId ORDER BY l.lap) AS cumulative_ms
    FROM lapTimes AS l
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
pit_clock AS (
    SELECT 1000 * CAST(strftime('%s', p.time) AS INTEGER) - l.cumulative_ms AS start_estimate_ms
    FROM pitStops AS p
    JOIN lap_clock AS l ON l.raceId = p.raceId AND l.driverId = p.driverId AND l.lap = p.lap
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pit_stops,
       MIN(start_estimate_ms) AS first_start_estimate_ms,
       MAX(start_estimate_ms) AS last_start_estimate_ms,
       MAX(start_estimate_ms) - MIN(start_estimate_ms) AS estimate_spread_ms,
       (SELECT l.cumulative_ms
        FROM lap_clock AS l
        JOIN results AS f ON f.raceId = l.raceId AND f.driverId = l.driverId AND f.laps = l.lap
        WHERE f.position = 1) AS winner_cumulative_ms
FROM pit_clock
